'''Alex Helmke'''<ref name="dt-13046">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/13046 throne room done right aka i wish i was huntawarya], DeckTech (Alex "aljex" Helmke, 19 January 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/13046/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/13046/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022110638/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/13046/ Wayback Machine].</ref> (DeckTech handle '''aljex''') posted a [[Light]] Massassi Throne Room mains list on DeckTech in January 2001.
